messages:
anya: Quick sync: ingest -> accounting handoff for claim/lease reconciliation. I want a minimal handshake so we can avoid double-claims, make dedupe deterministic, and keep a replayable audit trail. Thoughts?

matt: High-level sounds good. We need a clear contract: every 'claim' message must contain an idempotency key + a provenance pointer (request_root_id / token-line origin) and a sequence or checkpoint. Without that accounting can't dedupe safely.

kevin: Agree. Also add an explicit lifecycle state: tentative vs finalized vs revoked. That lets us accept provisional numbers quickly and reconcile later when final.

priya: Strong preference to keep ledger writes append-only. Any correction should be an additional record (correction/revocation), not an in-place mutation. Makes audits simpler.

liam: On leases: current short-lived lease + renewals model leaves room for orphan claims if a producer dies mid-handshake. We should surface lease-transfer or lease-expire events to finalizer so we don't leave dangling tentatives.

anya: Proposed minimal protobuf/json for the handshake (emitted by ingest producer):
```json
{
  "claim_id": "string",              // deterministic id for claim dedupe
  "idempotency_key": "string",     // sha256 or equivalent
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "provenance": { "request_id": "string", "request_root": "string", "model_version": "string" },
  "tokens": { "input": 123, "output": 456 },
  "amount": 579,                     // total token units used
  "status": "tentative|final|revoke",
  "checkpoint_ts": "iso8601 or epoch",
  "origin_region": "string"
}
```

matt: If we include checkpoint_ts we can do watermark-based compaction in accounting. Add origin_region for cross-region reconciliation/fallback.

kevin: For idempotency, propose claim_id = sha256(tenant_id + request_root + model_variant + window_epoch). Deterministic and stable even across retries. Document the exact concatenation and canonicalization.

priya: Audit plan: every state transition (tentative -> final -> revoke) should emit an audit-event to the audit topic containing raw ingest message + normalized claim. That gives full root-cause traceability.

liam: Operationally, implement a finalizer service that watches for leases that expired without a finalize event and emits compensating revoke claims. Make it configurable (grace period) per tenant.

anya: Migration suggestion: ingest emits both claim_v1 (current) and claim_v2 (new handshake) for 2 weeks. Accounting reads claim_v2 when feature flag enabled and compares totals. Roll forward only after sampling passes. Any objections?

matt: Plan looks good. Steps: 1) add claim_v2 emission, 2) accounting feature-flag to prefer v2 if present, 3) run both in parallel and compare per-tenant rollups, 4) cutover and deprecate v1. Need metrics and alerts.

kevin: Add a fuzzy-compare job that samples traces and calculates per-tenant delta. If discrepancy > 0.1% we alert on a paging channel. Also log discrepant examples for manual review.

priya: Also add a dry-run finalizer backfill to estimate how many unfinalized tentatives exist historically. Useful for capacity planning.

ingest-bot: deploy: ingest-producer v2 rolled to canary (us-east-1) emitting claim_v2 with checkpoint_ts.

anya: Great. I'll write an RFC follow-up with the proto, migration checklist, rollout plan, and owners. Proposed owners: matt (accounting integration), kevin (idempotency + dedupe), priya (audit stream), liam (finalizer).

matt: ack. I'll add schema CI checks and sample queries for tally comparison.

kevin: I'll post the id function pseudo and a short test harness next.

anya: Thanks everyone — I'll file the RFC follow-up and paste links here. :white_check_mark:
